o.naslov: Where the *Christian East* meets the people of today.
o.uvod: History, mission, vision and leadership of the St John Chrysostom Institute.
o.povijest_tekst: The St John Chrysostom Institute was founded at its founding assembly on 24 January 2024, with the blessing of Bishop Milan Stipić of the Eparchy of Križevci. By a special decision, the Eparchy of Križevci supported the founding and work of the Institute, based in Zagreb at Ulica sv. Ćirila i Metoda 1, as an institution dedicated to Eastern Christian spirituality and closely linked to the Study of Eastern Christian Spirituality. The Institute supports the work of the Study, and in 2026 the first students of the Study successfully defended their theses.
o.crta1: The Bishop of Križevci establishes the Study of Eastern Christian Spirituality
o.crta2: The founding assembly establishes the St John Chrysostom Institute
o.crta3: First thesis defences at the Study
o.misija_tekst: To promote Eastern Christian spirituality and theological and liturgical culture, and to preserve spiritual heritage, bringing together knowledge, faith and community action.
o.vizija_tekst: To be a place where the richness of the Christian East is lived, studied and handed on to new generations, in open encounter with other Christian traditions and with society today.
o.zastitnik_tekst: Archbishop of Constantinople and Doctor of the Church (c. 349–407), called Chrysostom, the “golden-mouthed”, for the power of his preaching. The Divine Liturgy still celebrated in the Eastern Churches bears his name.
o.vodstvo_opis: Board members and collaborators who look after the work of the Institute.

studij.oznaka: Study of Eastern Christian Spirituality · SIKD
studij.naslov: A three-year journey through *the spirituality of the Christian East.*
studij.uvod: An educational programme that brings together biblical and patristic theology, liturgy, iconography and spiritual tradition, with weekend classes in Zagreb.
studij.o_tekst: The Study of Eastern Christian Spirituality (SIKD) was established by Bishop Milan Stipić of the Eparchy of Križevci by a decision of 1 January 2024, to offer lay faithful education in Eastern Christian spirituality, liturgy, theology and related disciplines. It is intended for everyone who wishes to explore the richness of the Eastern Christian tradition in a structured way: believers, religious education teachers, catechists and anyone interested in the spirituality, liturgy and sacred art of the Christian East. The St John Chrysostom Institute has worked closely with the Study since its founding.
studij.ukratko_tekst: Key facts about the programme. For all information about the Study, please contact the SIKD Office.
studij.program_opis: The programme covers four interconnected areas.
studij.podrucje1_tekst: Holy Scripture as interpreted by the Church Fathers, with a special focus on the legacy of St John Chrysostom.
studij.podrucje2_tekst: The history, theology and practice of the Byzantine liturgical tradition.
studij.podrucje3_tekst: The theology and language of the icon as a window into the mystery of faith.
studij.podrucje4_tekst: Prayer, ascetic practice and spiritual life in the experience of the Christian East.
studij.prijave_tekst: Applications, pre-registration and all information about the Study of Eastern Christian Spirituality, enrolment, timetable and classes are handled by the SIKD Office.
studij.misija_tekst:
- To provide students with a better understanding of Eastern Christian spirituality, its history, theology and practice.
- To encourage students to explore and reflect on spiritual themes and to grow personally in their spiritual life.
- To promote understanding of the different spiritual traditions within Christianity and contribute to interreligious dialogue.
studij.vizija_tekst:
- To become the leading programme for the study of Eastern Christian spirituality, shaping future experts and leaders in this field.
- To inspire positive change in the world by promoting spiritual growth, understanding and peace.
- To build “bridges” between different spiritual traditions in order to foster dialogue, understanding and tolerance among people.
studij.plan_opis: Click a course for a short description. Classes combine lectures and independent work, and exams are oral or written.
studij.treca_napomena: In the third year, each student chooses a subject and, under a professor’s mentorship, studies it in depth and writes a final thesis.

price.uvod: Themed ecumenical evenings of the Study of Eastern Christian Spirituality at the Greek Catholic Parish of Sts Cyril and Methodius in Zagreb, next to Grič: encounters, conversations and testimonies of Christians from different traditions.

privatnost.uvod: How we handle your data when you visit this website or contact us.
privatnost.tekst:
Last updated: 22 November 2026.

## 1. Data controller

Institut Sveti Ivan Zlatousti (St John Chrysostom Institute), Ulica sv. Ćirila i Metoda 1, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia, OIB 41214716365. For any questions about personal data, write to institut.svetiivanzlatousti@gmail.com.

## 2. What data we process

- **Enquiry form and email.** When you write to us, we process your name, email address and the content of your message in order to reply. The legal basis is steps taken at your request and our legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(b) and (f) of the General Data Protection Regulation). Messages sent through the form are stored by the website hosting provider (Netlify) as a data processor.
- **Enrolment in the Study.** Data needed for enrolment and student records are processed by the Study Office for the purpose of running the programme and kept for as long as the law requires.
- **Technical data.** The server hosting this website may briefly log IP addresses and access times for security purposes.

The website does not use analytics or advertising tools and does not sell data to third parties. We keep enquiry data for as long as needed to respond and follow up.

## 3. Cookies and external content

The website does not set tracking cookies. Your browser only remembers your chosen language and whether you allowed the map to be shown.

- **Google Maps** loads only when you click “Show map”. Google may then process your IP address and set cookies in line with its own privacy policy.
- **Google Fonts:** fonts are loaded from Google’s servers, which see your IP address.
- **Links to Facebook and other websites** open in a new tab and are subject to those websites’ policies.

## 4. Photos

Photos from the life of the Institute may show identifiable people. We publish photos with the consent of the people shown or when they are taken at public events. If you would like us to remove a photo of you or your child, please email us and we will remove it without delay.

## 5. Your rights

You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict processing, to object and to data portability. Please send your request by email. If you believe your rights have been infringed, you may lodge a complaint with the Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency (AZOP), [azop.hr](https://azop.hr).

## 6. Changes

We may update this notice from time to time. The date of the last update is shown at the top.
